Officer's narrative
On arrival at the scene of a reported sideswipe during a lane change in Houston, Texas, I spoke with Driver 1 and
Driver 2. Driver 1 said Driver 2 drifted into their lane and struck the side of the vehicle, and reported neck and back
strain, which is a plausible injury pattern for a side impact of this kind. Driver 2 disputed this account. A Passenger in
Driver 1's vehicle and a bystander both confirmed that Driver 1 was inside the vehicle at the time. My inspection found
dents on the rear quarter panel, at a lower height than the contact area Driver 1 described, so the damage does not
match the satted point of impact. A traffic camera near the location recorded no collision there at the reported time.
Records and the vehicle's condition show no earlier damage. Driver 1 is listed on the policy covering the vehicle. I
recommend further review of the camera footage and the damage before any conclusions are drawn.
</page>
